Contract Generator.contract:
Contract SubmitLoanRequestModule::enterLoanInformation(requestid: Integer,name: String,loanamount: Real,loanpurpose: String,income: Real,phonenumber: Integer,postaladdress: String,zipcode: Integer,email: String,workreferences: String,creditreferences: String,checkingaccountnumber: Integer,securitynumber: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		currentLoanRequest: LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstance()->any(o|o.RequestID = requestid)
	precondition:
		LoanRequest.allInstance()->includes(currentLoanRequest) or
		LoanRequest.allInstance()->excludes(currentLoanRequest)
	postcondition:
		CurrentLoanRequest = currentLoanRequest and
		CurrentLoanRequest.RequestID = requestid and
		CurrentLoanRequest.Name = name and
		CurrentLoanRequest.LoanAmount = loanamount and
		CurrentLoanRequest.LoanPurpose = loanpurpose and
		CurrentLoanRequest.Income = income and
		CurrentLoanRequest.PhoneNumber = phonenumber and
		CurrentLoanRequest.PostalAddress = postaladdress and
		CurrentLoanRequest.ZipCode = zipcode and
		CurrentLoanRequest.Email = email and
		CurrentLoanRequest.WorkReferences = workreferences and
		CurrentLoanRequest.CreditReferences = creditreferences and
		CurrentLoanRequest.CheckingAccountNumber = checkingaccountnumber and
		CurrentLoanRequest.SecurityNumber = securitynumber and
		CurrentLoanRequest.Status = LoanRequestStatus::SUBMITTED and
		result = true
}
